values.note: 2026: electric $25 a night, electric and water $35, full hookup $40, plus taxes and fees; holiday nights $5 more. Weekly $120 / $175 / $200; full hookup $600 a month. Primitive tent sites $15 (plus $15 per extra tent).

fees.source: City page '2026 Campsite Fees' ('Primitive site – $15.00 (additional $15.00 per tent) + taxes and fees'; 'Electrical hook ups – $25.00'; 'Electrical and water – $35.00'; 'Full connections – $40.00'; 'Monthly Price: Full connections – $600.00'; 'Holiday Rates Daily' $20/$30/$40/$45), read 2026-11-11. The $15 primitive sites are the map's 'Primitive Tent' sites, so the base is the $25 electric site.

values.note: Online through Firefly or by phone. Electric, water-and-electric and tent sites take stays up to 10 days; nightly full-hookup sites up to 89 days; 20 full-hookup sites are seasonal-only (90-day minimum). The electric overflow sites (63-77) open only as overflow.

booking.source: City page ('Online camping reservations are open now'; BOOK NOW -> Firefly) + 2026 site map legend ('Electric - Daily/Weekly (10 day max)'; 'Electric/Water/Sewer - Daily/Weekly/Monthly (89 day max)'; 'Electric/Water/Sewer - Seasonal/Ongoing (90 day min)'; 'Overflow Camping Only'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: Firefly booking page ('Campground is open for the 2026 season May 15, 2026 through October 11, 2026.'), read 2026-11-11; the city page says 'CLOSED for the 2026 season'

hookups.source: City page ('47 sites with electric, water and sewer hook ups'), read 2026-11-11; amperage not stated, stored 50 left as it is

values.note: 47 full hookup (20 of them seasonal-only), 4 water and electric, 23 electric (about 15 of them in the overflow field); 3 tent-only sites besides.

sites.source: City page ('74 RV campsites'; '47 sites with electric, water and sewer hook ups'; '4 sites with water and electric hook ups'; '23 sites with electric hook ups'; '3 sites tent only') + 2026 site map colour legend, read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: City page amenities ('Comfort Station', 'Dump Station', 'Public Showers', 'Free WiFi'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Madelia campground in Watona Park beside the Watonwan River, next to the golf course, pool, ball fields and a disc golf course, within walking distance of downtown. --Claude
summary: City page, 2026 map and Firefly read: rates confirmed, base corrected $15 -> $25 (the $15 sites are tent-only); 74 RV sites (47 FH of which 20 seasonal-only, 4 W/E, 23 E incl. overflow); Firefly online booking; 2026 season May 15 - Oct 11; showers, dump, Wi-Fi. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Base rate corrected 15 -> 25: the $15 'Primitive site' is the map's 'Primitive Tent' class (sites 56, 57, 60 and 66/67 area), which a 23-ft rig can't use; the cheapest RV site is electric at $25. Stored fees provenance had no manual method.

Long-stay (local): 20 of 47 full-hookup sites (1-8, 15, 19, 20, 23, 26, 29, 32, 34, 37, 40, 43, 46 on the 2026 map) are 'Seasonal/Ongoing (90 day min)'; 54 of 74 RV sites are sold by the night. Not mostly seasonal.

Not waterfront kept: the nearest sites to the Watonwan River (55 and 59 on the south loop, ~44.0404,-94.4233 and ~44.0399,-94.4219) sit ~40-60 m from the river through a continuous wooded band on Esri imagery; the river is ~20 m wide (creek-sized).
Phone 507-380-9440 (campground line on the city page) confirmed; website confirmed.
Note cleaned: dropped the site mix, 50-amp/pull-thru, dump, 'online reservable; per city site' and the RV Life commercial-tag remark (ownership already says local).
